The dev stopped under order ruling 4 (report 6775681383): `blank/src/apps/index.ts` line 1 is the empty-barrel header that `renderEmptyWiredBarrel` in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` writes for every wired directory, and `create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts` pins the blank barrel to those bytes. It is the card's own text, so the seat folds it in here rather than opening a follow-up card.

File surface, added:
- `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`: the apps barrel only. `renderEmptyWiredBarrel` gets an app-specific header sentence (one app per package; add navigation to it, or replace it), mirroring PR #32291's `main.app.ts` wording. The objects and views headers stay byte-identical.
- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/apps/index.ts` stays in scope, rewritten to the new rendered bytes so the parity test holds unchanged.
- One cli test file, only if one pins the old apps header text; name it in the PR body.

Changeset: add `@objectstack/cli: patch` beside `create-objectstack: patch`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, unchanged. Stop on any further breach.

The blank starter's README, its `src/apps/main.app.ts` comment and the getting-started page no longer tell the author to generate a second app. They say to add a navigation entry to the starter app (a `group` entry nests entries) and give it a view with `objectstack generate view OBJECT`. The apps barrel header that `os init` writes (and the blank starter ships) says the same: one app per app package, generated while there is none, then navigation entries or a replacement. Every other barrel header is unchanged. `pm:dispatched` removed.
